name: uart_receptiontoidle_circulardma
description: UART_ReceptionToIdle_CircularDMA: USART2 receives into a 20-byte buffer by circular DMA, the HAL calling back on the half-transfer, the transfer-complete and the line going idle; each chunk is echoed. Text typed on the ST-LINK's virtual COM port comes back whole, also when it wraps the buffer.
